component.name: LCOS Command Center
component.summary: Unified settings for the Lunduke Computer Operating System

description.p: LCOS Command Center is a single settings window for LCOS. It covers display, desktop, appearance, window manager, accessibility, notifications, removable media, power, keyboard, mouse, sound, and default software, and writes the same xfconf channels the XFCE 4.20 settings tools use.
First release of LCOS Command Center for LCOS 1.1.0. Debian package 1.1.0-1.
First development snapshot for the LCOS 1.1 settings work.
